edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by _msgSender.
_msgSender() is compared against the router and pair to authorise cooldown-gated transfers.
transfer forwards _msgSender() as the sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender/allowance holder.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
The constructor mints the whole supply to _msgSender().
onlyOwner gate compares _owner with _msgSender() before renouncing ownership.
onlyOwner gate on setCooldownEnabled depends on _msgSender().
onlyOwner gate on openTrading depends on _msgSender().
onlyOwner gate on addLiquidity depends on _msgSender().
onlyOwner gate on setMaxTxPercent depends on _msgSender().
manualswap is authorised solely by comparing _msgSender() to _teamAddress.
manualsend is authorised solely by comparing _msgSender() to _teamAddress.
block.timestamp drives buy/sell cooldown and 24h window comparisons in _transfer.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
_msgSender() is stored into _owner during construction.
The constructor writes the initial owner.
owner() returns _owner.
renounceOwnership compares and clears _owner.
onlyOwner modifier on setCooldownEnabled reads _owner.
onlyOwner modifier on openTrading reads _owner.
onlyOwner modifier on addLiquidity reads _owner.
onlyOwner modifier on setMaxTxPercent reads _owner.
_transfer reads owner() to bypass limits and fee logic.
sendETHToFee pays half the ETH to _teamAddress.
manualswap requires the caller to equal _teamAddress.
manualsend requires the caller to equal _teamAddress.
sendETHToFee pays half the ETH to _marketingFunds.
swapTokensForEth calls functions on uniswapV2Router.
addLiquidity writes and calls uniswapV2Router.
_transfer uses uniswapV2Pair for pair checks and sell-limit math.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
_transfer requires tradingOpen before allowing buys.
addLiquidity enables swapEnabled.
_transfer branches on swapEnabled for the auto-swap path.
addLiquidity enables cooldownEnabled.
setCooldownEnabled writes cooldownEnabled.
_transfer branches on cooldownEnabled for limits and caller checks.
setMaxTxPercent recomputes _maxTxAmount.
_transfer enforces _maxTxAmount on buys and sells.
addLiquidity raises _maxTxAmount after launch.
addLiquidity sets liquidityAdded to true.
openTrading requires liquidityAdded.
lockTheSwap sets inSwap around swapTokensForEth.
_transfer checks !inSwap before triggering the auto-swap.
_transfer requires the sender and recipient not to be blacklisted bots.
_transfer reads and writes buycooldown to throttle buys.
_transfer reads and writes sellcooldown to throttle sells.
_transfer uses firstsell to detect the 24h window reset.
_transfer increments sellnumber to escalate cooldowns.
sellnumber is multiplied into the fee values inside setFee.
_transfer checks _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take fees.
balanceOf converts _rOwned entries into token balances.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned.
_takeTeam credits _rOwned of the contract.
transferFrom reads _allowances to subtract the spent amount.
approve writes into _allowances via _approve.
transfer delegates the whole movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the movement to _transfer.
transferFrom approves the reduced allowance through _approve.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_transfer calls balanceOf for the contract and pair balances.
_transfer executes the external router swap before the trailing setFee state change.
_transfer sends ETH out to external addresses before fee state finalisation.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer to perform the actual movement.
_transfer calls setFee with sellnumber, multiplying tax and team fees.
_transfer invokes restoreAllFee (as a statement) after the internal transfer.
swapTokensForEth approves the router via _approve.
swapTokensForEth makes an external call into the Uniswap router.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to _teamAddress.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to _marketingFunds.
addLiquidity approves the router through _approve.
addLiquidity makes an external addLiquidityETH call.
addLiquidity makes an external factory createPair call.
addLiquidity makes an external approve call on the pair token.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee on the contract ETH balance.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee for fee-exempt transfers.
_tokenTransfer restores fees after a fee-exempt transfer.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee.
_takeTeam obtains the current rate from _getRate.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues calls _getRate.
_getRate reads the supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply.
setFee multiplies _taxFee by the sell multiplier.
setFee conditionally overrides _teamFee with 10.
balanceOf converts reflections through tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection uses _getRate to compute the token amount.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter is consumed entirely inside _transfer; folding it into the transfer node removes a redundant leaf.
The from parameter only exists to drive _transfer's cooldown and blacklist logic, so it merges into that function.
The to parameter is only used for _transfer's buy-limit and blacklist checks, so it merges into that function.
The tAmount parameter of _transferStandard is a pure input to the reflection computation of that function.
The local balance snapshot is only the argument handed to swapTokensForEth, so it merges into that function.
The local ETH balance is only the argument handed to sendETHToFee, so it merges into that function.
The takeFee boolean only controls whether _tokenTransfer removes or restores fees, so it merges into that function.
